resolution_rules.rule: Prefer the customer's confirmed project-specific requirement when safe, feasible, and within applicable constraints.
Do not promise infeasible functionality. Explain the constraint and offer verified alternatives.
resolution_rules.if_unresolved: Escalate to the technical owner and customer.

resolution_rules.rule: Compare authority, scope, date, jurisdiction, methodology, and applicability.
resolution_rules.if_unresolved: Record both sources and seek qualified review when material.

resolution_rules.rule: Prefer sufficiently verified current evidence when it applies to the same question.
resolution_rules.if_unresolved: Mark the claim unverified and obtain updated evidence.

resolution_rules.rule: Do not sacrifice a required user task or approved workflow merely to preserve a visual design.
resolution_rules.if_unresolved: Rework the design and validate the workflow.

resolution_rules.rule: Do not bypass mandatory safeguards to achieve a business goal. Identify safer alternatives.
resolution_rules.if_unresolved: Block the unsafe action and route for authorized review.

resolution_rules.rule: Compare underlying evidence, assumptions, dependencies, and decision ownership rather than voting between agents.
resolution_rules.if_unresolved: Create a conflict record and route it to the accountable owner.

resolution_rules.rule: Treat the new request as a proposed scope change, not as automatically approved work.
resolution_rules.if_unresolved: Obtain the required customer decision before implementation.

prohibited_behaviors: Choosing whichever agent responds most confidently
Treating general industry knowledge as stronger than verified project evidence without reason
Inventing a compromise that satisfies neither requirement
Allowing customer preference to bypass mandatory safety controls
